index-missing.summary: A declared prose graph with >= 100 units and >= 20000 words has no LSI index sidecar. Basis: a HOUSE threshold, not from the method (the 1990 paper gives no corpus-size rule) — more prose than one reader holds in a sitting, so a change of vocabulary between two units goes unnoticed. Graphs below either threshold are not judged (n/a, not pass); state graphs (beans) are indexed on demand and never asked for one.
